paragraphs.source_en: On the third day of the seventh month of Bunroku 4, the kanpaku Hidetsugu presented the Imperial Court with three thousand ingots of silver. On the fifth, Hidetsugu sent Kimura Hitachinosuke to Fushimi Castle to submit yet another oath declaring that he harbored no disloyal intentions whatsoever.
